description: This file implements the MessageClient class within the Thunder::Messaging namespace. It manages message buffers, factories for message deserialization, and provides methods for adding/removing instances, waiting for updates, enabling/disabling messages, and processing messages from buffers.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: A class that manages message buffers, message factories, and provides mechanisms for message handling, including adding/removing instances, waiting for updates, and processing messages.

methods.name: MessageClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MessageClient with identifier, base path, and socket port.

methods.name: AddInstance
methods.description: Adds a message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.name: RemoveInstance
methods.description: Removes the message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Blocks until updates are available in any buffer or timeout occurs.

methods.name: SkipWaiting
methods.description: Forces waiting operations to stop or flush buffers.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables messages based on metadata.

methods.name: Modules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently announced message modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves message controls for a specific module.

methods.name: PopMessagesAndCall
methods.description: Pops all messages from buffers and calls a handler for each message.

methods.name: AddFactory
methods.description: Registers a factory for a specific message type.

methods.name: RemoveFactory
methods.description: Unregisters the factory for a specific message type.
